about: The learner's ordered to-do list of lessons (2026-10-15: one queue instead of the weekly block plan). The Today page shows the daily review, then the first 3 unfinished items here as today's work. Claude keeps it current: add each new lesson where it belongs, reorder when priorities change. Finished lessons (rated, mostly answered, or in a curriculum's 'completed') drop off by themselves. Optional per item: note (shown under the link).

items.note: Pick up at the reading notes left (which rounds are in both loops; a surprise note is in), then the 35-minute coding round. Day 2 is the rest of the page.
Two days: day 1 is the reading and Parts 1–3; day 2 is Parts 4–5.
The warm-up is done; start at the reading.
